alternative-uses-task.alt: One everyday object opens into several kinds of use; each branch adds a different category to the idea list.
alternative-uses-task.caption: One object can produce many ideas; grouping those ideas shows flexibility as well as fluency.

ask-a-crab.alt: An unrelated picture prompts associations, which lead to several workplace ideas without choosing a winner.
ask-a-crab.caption: Keep the visible path from picture to association to idea; selection happens later.

follow-dogme-95-rules.alt: A temporary rule shapes one version beside a freer version; the two are compared for surprise, fit, and craft.
follow-dogme-95-rules.caption: The rule is a temporary making condition. Compare what it forces with what the brief needs.

hits-and-dot-voting.alt: Silent small marks identify promising parts across the idea board; a separate larger vote selects one idea.
hits-and-dot-voting.caption: Notice interesting parts before debate, then make the final selection visible as a separate decision.

imposing-constraints.alt: A wide draft is reshaped inside a deliberate constraint; some paths close while new formal moves become possible.
imposing-constraints.caption: A constraint narrows the field and can make new moves possible; keep or reject the result against the brief.

mental-locks-audit.alt: A belief blocks a dropped idea; a temporary opposite rule opens a short test before the student decides what to do.
mental-locks-audit.caption: The belief is tested through making—not graded as a personal confession.

one-inch-picture-frame.alt: A broad brief narrows to one small visible moment; a partner's observation and an unanswered question guide the next move.
one-inch-picture-frame.caption: Frame one observable moment. What is outside it becomes a useful question for the next design move.

process-trail.alt: Ordered versions show ideas opening and closing; one marked turning point explains why the design direction changed.
process-trail.caption: The trail makes the process legible: keep discarded options and mark the moment judgment changed direction.

question-led-rough-prototype.alt: One test question shapes a minimal prototype, which a classmate tries; the answer determines the next design move.
question-led-rough-prototype.caption: Build only enough to answer the question; let the test response—not polish—set the next move.

random-word-stimulation.alt: One random word branches into three links to the brief; one link becomes a design move while the others remain visible.
random-word-stimulation.caption: Keep the associative path visible so the lateral jump can be explained and revisited.

reflection-in-action-log.alt: Making produces a surprise; the student records the situation's response, changes strategy, and returns to making.
reflection-in-action-log.caption: Reflection happens during the work: notice its response, change a move, and see what the new move makes possible.

seed-collection.alt: Several unranked starting points are gathered, three are developed in different directions, and one is kept with a reason.
seed-collection.caption: Delay ranking: collect broadly, develop a few seeds, then choose what has grown and why.

visitor-journey-walkthrough.alt: A first-time visitor's route yields observed moments; one prior idea is selected against a recorded moment and criterion.
visitor-journey-walkthrough.caption: Choose against what the walkthrough revealed, not against taste; keep the unresolved question visible.
